summary: Real Messenger Corp filed a Form 6-K disclosing it regained compliance with Nasdaq's $2.5M stockholders' equity requirement after a best-efforts offering of 5,714,284 units at $0.70/unit, raising $4.0M gross ($3.5M net). The offering closed June 9, 2026. Nasdaq granted an extension to October 3, 2026, but compliance was achieved upon closing. The filing is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
